d:
From a subdued airport welcome to an awkward interaction with Donald Trump, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi found herself at the centre of diplomatic optics at China's APEC summit.
While Xi Jinping personally welcomed Trump and other world leaders received elaborate receptions, Takaichi was greeted with little fanfare. Images of her struggling to descend her aircraft stairs also drew attention in Japan. At the summit, Xi sat beside Trump, while Takaichi was seated seven places away. The two leaders exchanged handshakes but held no bilateral meeting.
